system.description:
A miniaturized self-destruct system functions as a normal Self-Destruct System, but it functions as if the droid were two sizes larger. This costs 5 times as much as a normal Self-Destruct System.

DROID SIZE DAMAGE
Diminutive 4d6
Tiny 6d6
Small 8d6
Medium 10d6
Large or Larger 20d6

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Web Enhancements (Star Wars Miniatures Previews)
